blocking_findings.detail: The pane claimed V2 contained the corrected consistency basis, seven-surface matrix, Lana-bound decisions, and separated 200-WPM policy. The actual JSON has only receipt_id, operation_timestamp, and lanes. It contains no consistency matrix, headers, rails, banner language, colour roles, viewer-facing card grammar, section/end-card decisions, reading-rate policy, derived reading times, or defective-card ledger. The initial 36-defect verdict is therefore not reproduced by this file.

Every card says visible text is formed by concatenating display_citation, every string in params, and visual_action. visual_action is renderer instruction prose, not necessarily audience-visible copy. Spin examples count sentences such as 'A conceptual all-sky field assembles...' as visible words; the original Goru report itself described visual_action as unstructured prose instructions. Sibling extraction also admits internal schema values such as plane, archive, semantic, paired_strokes, and expression. Forty-four cards contain at least one of those known internal tokens. Whitespace arithmetic is internally consistent, but it does not measure actual on-screen readable words.

The ledger has no renderer-specific allowlist proving which params fields are painted, no field-to-frame mapping, and no OCR/frame comparison. It cannot distinguish visible labels from animation instructions, icon types, colour-role tokens, or layout keys.

Motion records provide 2-fps summaries and a 0.08 threshold, but metric_definition says mean/max absolute pixel difference without selecting which statistic drives near-unchanged classification, specifying luma/RGB scale and frame resolution, or providing the consecutive-sample series/run boundaries needed to reproduce longest_near_unchanged_seconds.

V2 binds selected inputs but does not bind the extraction code/command, its hash, outputs, runtime versions, or a manifest for the correction packet. The operation_timestamp alone is not a derivation receipt.

requirements: Include the actual seven-surface consistency matrix and the Lana-bound rationale for each which-is-right decision in the frozen packet.

Derive visible word counts from renderer-confirmed painted fields only, using a per-renderer allowlist bound to renderer hashes; exclude visual_action and internal style/icon/layout values unless exact frame evidence proves they are drawn.
Include per-card exact frame/time binding and an OCR or renderer draw-call cross-check that proves the extracted tokens are audience-visible.
State the reading-rate policy separately and regenerate the defect table from corrected visible-word counts and measured dwell times.
Define the motion scalar and scale unambiguously, include the consecutive-sample series and run boundaries, and bind the extraction command/code/hash/runtime.
Add a packet manifest that binds all inputs, code, ledgers, decisions, and outputs.
